# Portfolix v0.1.11 (Build 23)
## 资产记账
- 重新设计持仓管理：通过“添加资产”录入新资产或增持已有资产，可选择外部新增资金或已有现金账户支付，并将手续费计入成本。 - 新增“卖出资产”，支持部分卖出和全部卖出，自动更新剩余份额、持仓成本、收款现金余额及已实现盈亏。现金资产通过“减少现金”记录部分或全部转出，不作为卖出计算盈亏。 - 新增统一交易记录，包含倒序序号、精确到秒的记录时间、份额、成交价格、手续费及已实现盈亏；可在右键菜单中撤销记录，并重新计算相关持仓与现金。 - 旧版持仓自动生成期初记录，以兼容新的记账方式；无法可靠还原的期初信息可先核对确认。移除直接删除持仓和批量修改余额的入口，避免绕过操作记录。 - 同步适配历史收益、盈亏日历、投资云图、行情更新、智能分析、MCP 和备份恢复，避免将资金转入转出误计为投资收益，或让后台行情覆盖已更新的份额。
## 智能分析与投资分布
- Agent 可按需调用只读持仓、历史收益和交易记录工具，不再依赖先生成报告才能获取组合数据。 - 精简上下文并限制工具与修复调用预算；在每条回答下方显示本次回答消耗的 tokens。 - 统一报告与问答的表达风格，减少重复和机械化文案；支持加粗、斜体、下划线及列表等基础 Markdown 显示。 - 投资分布优先识别资产实际投资领域，按资产身份缓存分类，新增或身份变化时按需补充分类；价格和份额变化仅重算金额及占比。未配置 AI 或分类失败时保留本地分类回退。 - 修复分类批次中部分失败导致已完成结果丢失，以及模型最终回复为空时误用中间内容的问题。
## 界面与兼容性
- 新增可折叠侧边栏，优化图标对齐、页面切换稳定性及收起状态的新版本提示。 - 新增绿涨红跌、红涨绿跌配色选择，统一数字变化动画，优化日历日期描边与卡片高度。 - 调整浅色与深色背景为更中性的黑白色，统一空状态提示字体。 - 将弹窗报错和验证反馈统一放在固定底栏，每次仅显示当前操作对应的一条提示；修复添加资产时需要点击两次确认的问题。 - 隐藏不支持自动行情资产的刷新按钮，改善持仓与交易记录的序号对齐、币种切换及表格交互。 - 加强只读 MCP 协议兼容性、输入边界和数据访问控制，新增交易与已清仓记录查询，并提供主流 Agent 客户端的紧凑配置参考。 - 统一隐藏页面滚动条，减少不同 Mac 系统设置造成的外观差异。
升级前建议先导出备份。所有添加、卖出和现金转出均为本地记账，不会执行真实交易。安装要求：Apple Silicon Mac，macOS 15 或更高版本。
## Asset Records
- Redesigned holding management: add new assets or increase existing positions, optionally fund additions from recorded cash, and include fees in the cost basis. - Record partial or full sales with updated remaining quantities, cost bases, cash proceeds, and realized P&L. Reduce cash through partial or full withdrawals without treating principal flows as investment losses. - Added a unified transaction ledger with descending row numbers, timestamps including seconds, prices, fees, and realized P&L. Reverse records from the context menu and recalculate related holdings and cash. - Migrate existing holdings into opening records, with confirmation available where the original balance cannot be reliably reconstructed. Removed direct holding deletion and bulk balance-editing entry points. - Updated historical returns, the P&L calendar, investment map, quote synchronization, AI tools, MCP, and backup recovery for the new ledger.
## AI Analysis and Distribution
- Let the Agent request read-only holdings, history, and transaction data when needed, without requiring an existing analysis report. - Reduced redundant context and bounded tool and repair calls. Display the tokens consumed by each answer. - Unified report and chat tone, improved concise explanations, and added basic Markdown rendering for emphasis, underlines, and lists. - Classify underlying investment sectors per asset and reuse cached classifications. Revalue amounts and percentages without reclassifying on price or quantity changes; retain local fallbacks when AI is unavailable. - Preserve completed classifications when later batches fail, and reject provisional content when the final model response is empty.
## Interface and Compatibility
- Added a collapsible sidebar with aligned icons, stable navigation, and compact update notifications. - Added gain/loss color conventions, consistent numeric transitions, refined calendar outlines, and balanced card heights. - Refined neutral light and dark surfaces and standardized empty-state typography. - Consolidated sheet feedback into a fixed footer with one current message, and fixed asset submission requiring a second click. - Improved table numbering, currency conversion, and refresh controls for assets without automatic quotes. - Hardened read-only MCP compatibility and access boundaries, added transaction and closed-holding queries, and refined client configuration references. - Hide page scroll indicators consistently across Mac system preferences.
Export a backup before upgrading. Asset additions, sales, and cash withdrawals only update local records; they never execute real trades. Requires an Apple Silicon Mac running macOS 15 or later.
